review_scope: Privacy, tenant request-context separation, HTTP/static exposure, local filesystem permissions and retention meaning. Independent writer-failure/atomicity review belongs to verify_b.

findings.claim: Real raster app registers no StaticFiles/Mount for upload root or diagnostic directory. Receipt JSON is not downloadable by tenant-a or tenant-b via direct guessed paths or offline-pack/traversal paths, even supplying valid service token.

Storage stats directly require the service credential, returning aggregate file/size counters only; no bbox, receipt id or tenant hash. This is the service route contract, not a claim that every upstream authenticated proxy imposes an operator role.
A field owned by tenant-a rejects missing tenant and tenant-b before CDSE normalization/provider work or diagnostic receipt creation.

Two authorized ASGI requests preserve distinct request tenant and field digests through asynchronous failure recording; raw tenant/field strings and provider exception text are absent, request context resets.
Fresh diagnostic directory is0700 and lock/receipt files0600; user identifiers never become path segments.
Two simultaneous ASGI requests with provider threads forced to rendezvous preserve distinct tenant/field receipt digests; request context resets after both complete.

privacy_and_retention_limits: These are operator-only diagnostic records, not anonymized/public artifacts. Bbox coordinates remain sensitive; unkeyed SHA-256 hides free-form identifiers from the file but does not make low-entropy identifiers unrecoverable.

A single per-service256-record rolling failure window is shared across tenants; interrupted rotation can retain257 records, declared as max_unrotated_receipts and reconciled before another append. No per-tenant guarantee or time-based expiry; rare failures can remain until displaced.

No HTTP read/list endpoint is added for receipts. Any later tenant-facing diagnostic endpoint needs explicit tenant authorization and constrained projection; directory naming by UUID is not authorization.
Default UPLOAD_DIR is /tmp/sahool_rasters. Restart/host-loss durability depends on deployed volume; live mount ownership, persistence and backup evidence were not measured here.

File permissions provide an OS-user boundary, not isolation between raster API/backfill/cache processes sharing the same UID and volume. Such service processes remain within the trusted operator boundary.

Main v9 nginx proxies raster requests, not files from the volume. Default raster-tiler-service has no raster-data volume; optional legacy TiTiler shares it read-only but no new raw diagnostic HTTP endpoint was introduced or tested in that optional container.

Review certifies receipt projection and tested access paths, not every existing log statement or infrastructure log exposure. Runtime warning errors now use exception type; some operational logs intentionally retain field id, bbox and date context.

test.network: none; httpx ASGITransport and provider failure stub

source_hash_limitation: Four reviewed source/test files hash-identical before and after the final6case run.
